---
title: "fit_single_patient"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse)
source("functions.R")
set.seed(1)
```



load in data sim_data
```{r}
#best fitting strobl patient and its fitted params (the "true" values for the simulation)
true_params <- get_n_best_fits(1)
patient_id  <- true_params$PatientId

sim_data <- simulate_best_strobl_fits(n=1, sigma=.025) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PSA_simulated, PSA_observed), names_to="Metric", values_to="PSA") |>
  filter(Metric == "PSA_observed")


```
prep it for stan
```{r}
#treatment indicator: one 0/1 value per day, built from the full clinical data (incl. rows with missing PSA)
clinical_data <- load_bruchowsky_patients(patient_id)[[as.character(patient_id)]]
sched <- build_treatment_schedule(clinical_data)

treatment_indicator <- rep(sched$dose, times = sched$end - sched$start)
treatment_indicator <- c(treatment_indicator, tail(treatment_indicator, 1)) #cover the last day


#observations: drop t = 0, since ode times must be after the starting time
obs <- sim_data |> filter(time > 0)

stan_data <- list(
  N                   = nrow(obs),
  measurement_times   = obs$time,
  PSA_norm            = obs$PSA,
  T                   = length(treatment_indicator),
  treatment_indicator = as.integer(treatment_indicator),
  rS = 0.027, K = 1, dD = 1.5
)
```

fit model
```{r}
mod <- cmdstan_model(here::here("stan/prototype_model.stan"))

fit <- mod$sample(data = stan_data, chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, seed = 1)
```

diagnostics
```{r}
fit$diagnostic_summary()

fit$summary(c("cost", "turnover", "n0", "rFrac", "sigma"))

#compare against the strobl values used to simulate the data
true_params |>
  mutate(rFrac = R0 / (S0 + R0)) |>
  select(cost, turnover, n0, rFrac)
```
